criteria.text: ft-text: each of upper, lower, title, replace (replace:find="a",with="b", every occurrence), indent (indent=N spaces on every non-empty line, default 2), quote (a JSON-style double-quoted string) and round (round=N decimal places, default 0) gives the expected output for a table of inputs, including empty, number, boolean and non-string input coerced to text first; no existing filter output changes
ft-params: a missing required parameter (replace without find, round or indent with a non-integer) or a parameter the filter does not declare is a type-error located at the variable, in every mode
ft-default: default="x" replaces a value that is not truthy (missing, null, empty text, 0, false, empty list, empty object); the existing ?? keeps its current behaviour in this card
